summary_md:
# Techras globalt – så har förvaltaren agerat

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Mats Wandrell, manager of the Alfred Berg Gamba global fund, discusses the sharp sell-off in US tech. Nasdaq has given up its year-to-date gains because of doubts about AI capex, the forced departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and US probes into chip sales to China. He compares the situation to Cisco in 2000 but argues that valuations and customer balance sheets are stronger now. The fund has been underweighting Nvidia, semiconductors and hardware while adding healthcare (Eli Lilly, Royalty Pharma), Microsoft and beaten-down software. Apple is its largest position, it skipped the Anthropic IPO and does not own Tesla. Its only Swedish holdings are Clas Ohlson and Cloetta.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 NVDA — Nvidia | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fund cut Nvidia to ~3%, underweight vs index; wants more than a bounce before reassessing and may keep selling

#### Reasoning

Guest fund manager: valuation is low (P/E under 10 with 60-70% earnings growth), but the CEO exit with no clear strategy, the China export probe and questions about circular financing create uncertainty that will weigh on the stock for some time. The fund holds it mainly for risk-budget reasons.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China probe clears with no findings
- if a credible new CEO and strategy are announced
- if sustained recovery beyond a single bounce

> *"Vi kanske till och med fortsätter sälja lite. Med tanke på att en osäkerhet som har skapats nu kommer att hänga över aktien en period, gissar jag."*

---

### 🟡 AAPL — Apple | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund's largest position; stable, free of the AI risk

#### Reasoning

Guest holds Apple as the top position because it has been stable through the tech sell-off and lacks the AI capex risk of the other megacaps.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Apple becomes exposed to AI capex risk
- if sentiment turns negative

> *"Apple är vår största position just nu. Den har varit relativt stabil under det senaste kvartalet."*

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Position increased substantially in summer as software sector re-rated

#### Reasoning

Guest rotated from semis/hardware into software. Microsoft was a key addition when the sector started to look attractive again, and software has held up better than hardware.

#### Sell Triggers

- if software sentiment reverses
- if AI spending disappoints

> *"Microsoft ökade vi på ganska ordentligt i somras i samband med att mjukvarusektorn började se intressant ut igen."*

---

### 🟢 LLY — Eli Lilly | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Healthcare exposure increased since summer, positive sentiment

#### Reasoning

Guest's fundamental plus sentiment model favored pharma since summer. Adding healthcare at the expense of semis helped the fund weather the turbulence.

#### Sell Triggers

- if healthcare sentiment turns negative

> *"Eli Lilly är ett exempel"*

---

### 🟢 RPRX — Royalty Pharma | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Smaller healthcare/biotech holding added in sector tilt

#### Reasoning

Part of the guest's increased healthcare exposure, driven by positive sector sentiment since summer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if healthcare sentiment turns negative

> *"Biotech, Royalty Pharma är ett annat exempel."*

---

### ⛔ TSLA — Tesla | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Not owned; hard to value fundamentally

#### Reasoning

Guest's process needs fundamental support alongside sentiment. Tesla is excluded because its valuation is hard to justify.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fundamentals become calculable/supportive

> *"Tesla äger vi inte av just det här skälet och att vi tycker det är svårt att räkna på bolaget"*

---

### 🟢 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

One of two Swedish holdings; strong CEO execution and share returns

#### Reasoning

Guest holds Clas Ohlson in the global fund and praises the CEO's execution and the stock's strong multi-year performance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if CEO departs
- if earnings momentum fades

> *"Vi har Clas Ohlson, som har varit en fantastisk historia de senaste åren, med en vd som gör väldigt mycket bra saker."*

---

### 🟢 CLA-B — Cloetta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Swedish holding; international expansion, strong share performance this year

#### Reasoning

Guest owns Cloetta, citing an exciting international expansion and strong price momentum this year, which fits the fund's sentiment-driven approach.

#### Sell Triggers

- if international expansion falters
- if momentum reverses

> *"Sen har vi även Cloetta, som alla känner till. De håller nu på med en internationell expansion, vilket ska bli spännande."*

---
